note: Candidate mutation coverage for L1 modular 2.3. It preserves the 2.2 defects and adds deterministic concurrency, external-data synchronization, reconnect recovery, and already-open review-list defects.

mutations.desc: Drop FOR UPDATE from the positive-stock row selection so simultaneous buyers can select the same units.
A purchase still creates an order but updates the selected stock row by zero, so the rush ends at start plus five instead of start plus two.

edits.find:
UPDATE stock s SET quantity = quantity - 1
         FROM target t
edits.replace:
UPDATE stock s SET quantity = quantity
         FROM target t

mutations.desc: The restock endpoint accepts the request but preserves the existing quantity, breaking both the ordinary restock precondition and the race total.
The cart upsert ignores an add that conflicts with an existing line.

edits.find: ON CONFLICT (cart_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = cart_item.quantity + excluded.quantity
edits.replace: ON CONFLICT (cart_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = cart_item.quantity

mutations.desc: Keep checked-out cart lines so the second checkout creates a duplicate order.

edits.find: await client.query(`DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = $1`, [cartId]);
